verdict.rationale: Brex's integrations page promises 'automatic syncing across 1,000s of native integrations' covering 'card swipe to month-end close.' It also documents an Accounting API, automated GL coding by entity, and one-click accruals, which together point to automated syncing of transactions and expenses into accounting. However, the evidence never names a specific accounting system or describes how the sync works. missing for 10: named accounting-software integrations (e.g., specific ERPs/GLs), documentation of sync behavior (what syncs, how often, one-way vs two-way), independent or hands-on corroboration
